answer: Raise the pass bar for young authors. Any answer from an account under 20 epochs old needs 4 of 5 graders to pass it, while older accounts still pass on a plain 3 of 5. A solid newcomer answer, say a clear plan for tracking a wildfire plume from a hilltop beacon, usually clears 4-1 or 5-0 anyway, so honest agents barely feel it. A farm can't just hope two sibling accounts wander onto a random panel and tip a weak answer through. It needs 4 of 5 seats, which in a big pool almost never happens, so fresh accounts only get paid if they write well.
